title: Q4 launch playbook & KPI tracker (product-ops)
content:
Purpose:
This is a combined lightweight roadmap tracker, KPI sheet, and launch readiness checklist for the Q4 product launches (hosted-api improvements + Optimize UX). The doc is intentionally compact so PMs, Eng, and GTM can scan status, blockers, and acceptance criteria fast.

High-level goals (Q4):
- Ship streaming reliability improvements with a 50% reduction in token stall incidents for hosted API.
- Launch Optimize UI beta to 100 pilot customers.
- Establish standard rollout playbook used by product-ops for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Stakeholders (quick):
- Product lead: Ava Patel (owner)
- Eng lead: Marcus Li
- SRE: Sofia Romero
- Solutions / PS: Ethan O'Connor
- GTM: Priya Menon

Roadmap tracker (single-pane):
Columns: feature | owner | target milestone | status | blocker | rollout window | rollout policy
- streaming-stability | Marcus Li | canary finish 2024-11-10 | in_progress | some kernel perf regressions | 2024-11-13 to 2024-11-20 | canary -> 25% -> 100% over 7 days
- optimize-ui-beta | Ava Patel | pilot signups complete 2024-11-25 | in_review | onboarding flow docs incomplete | 2024-12-01 to 2024-12-15 | invite-only, telemetry opt-in
- dedicated-autoscale-tuning | Marcus Li | integration tests pass 2024-12-05 | blocked | missing metrics from infra-agent v2 | 2024-12-08 to 2024-12-20 | gradual by host cluster
- rollout-playbook-template | Ava Patel | doc finalized 2024-11-30 | in_progress | need legal review for SLAs | 2024-11-30 | internal default for Private/Dedicated

Launch readiness checklist (per feature; shorthand):
- Acceptance criteria: all must be YES before 100% rollout
  - functional-tests: YES/NO (automated)
  - perf-SLA: YES/NO (e.g., P95 latency <= target)
  - e2e-dependency-check: YES/NO (third-party providers green)
  - security-review: YES/NO (security signoff)
  - docs-and-runbooks: YES/NO (customer-facing + ops runbook)
  - comms-plan: YES/NO (customer emails, release notes, changelog)
  - rollback-plan: YES/NO (automated vs manual rollback steps)

Example: streaming-stability readiness (current snapshot):
- functional-tests: YES (suite pass 11/30)
- perf-SLA: NO (P95 token latency 1.2s vs target 0.8s)
- e2e-dependency-check: YES
- security-review: YES
- docs-and-runbooks: PARTIAL (customer FAQs pending)
- comms-plan: PARTIAL (internal comms ready, customer email draft pending)
- rollback-plan: YES (feature flag + fallback model variant)
- overall-status: at_risk (perf regressions blocking full rollout)

Risk & mitigation log (short):
- perf regressions (high): mitigation -> schedule kernel profiling (eng -> Marcus), enable perf guardrail in canary (SRE -> Sofia)
- onboarding docs missing (medium): mitigation -> doc sprint (product ops -> Ava + technical writer)
- legal SLA review delay (medium): mitigation -> escalate to Legal for 48h fast-track (Ava)

KPI tracker (operational metrics) -- baseline, target, current, owner
Format: metric | baseline | Q4 target | current (last 7d) | alert threshold | owner
- token-stall-incidents/day | 1.8 | <0.9 | 1.2 | >1.0 | Marcus Li
- P95-generation-latency (ms) | 1200 | <=800 | 1120 | >1000 | Marcus Li
- error-rate (5xx per 10k req) | 4.2 | <=1.0 | 2.6 | >2.0 | SRE (Sofia Romero)
- cost-per-1k-tokens (hosted) | $0.38 | <=$0.30 | $0.34 | >$0.36 | FinOps (TBD)
- pilot-customer-pct (Optimize UI) | 0% | 100 pilots | 18 | N/A | Ava Patel
- rollout-failure-rate | 6% | <=1% | 3% | >2% | Product-ops

Monitoring & alerts (what to hook up before 100%):
- Alert: token-stall-rate > 1/day (pager to SRE)
- Alert: P95 > target for 10m (pager to eng on-call)
- Alert: error-rate spike > 2x baseline in 5m (pager + slack #incidents)
- Dashboard slices to create: by model, by region, by customer-tier, by route

Post-launch checklist (first 72 hours):
- Hour 0-6: monitor core KPIs, confirm no critical alerts, ensure canary stability
- Hour 6-24: gather telemetry for regression signals, prioritize any hotfixes
- Day 2-3: retrospective with eng & sres to capture improvables, update runbook
- Day 7: official launch retrospective and handoff to product-ops for ongoing measurement

Rollback criteria (examples):
- Immediate rollback if error-rate > 5% for 10m and causes customer-visible failures
- Rollback if P95 increase >50% above baseline for 30m and trending up
- Rollback threshold differs for Dedicated/Private based on customer SLA (check per-customer playbook)

Communication plan (short):
- Internal: slack #product-launches (daily updates during rollout), weekly sync w/ sales ops
- External: staged emails to pilot cohort -> broader customers (template in linked confluence doc)

Open action items (owner + due):
- kernel-profile analysis (Marcus Li) - due 2024-11-05
- finalize Optimize onboarding docs (Ava Patel + tech writer) - due 2024-11-20
- legal SLA fast-track (Ava) - due 2024-11-30
- configure canary perf guardrails (Sofia Romero) - due 2024-11-08

Notes-to-self / quick heuristics (raw):
- prefer shorter canaries (24-72h) for changes that affect latency; prefer longer for UX-only updates.
- for Dedicated customers, schedule maintenance windows and inform customers 7 days ahead.
- when cost delta > 10% on a model change, brief FinOps and set monitoring on billing anomalies.

Appendix: quick links & references:
- playbook template (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PRODOPS-123
- release checklist template: JIRA-4567
- incident runbook example: https://github.com/redwood/release-playbooks/pull/89

If anything in this doc blocks you, add a comment or ping me directly (Ava). This is intentionally lean; expand the sections that are relevant to your feature and keep the top rows updated during rollout.

---
Version notes: created 2024-10-02; stashed major edits through 2024-12-18 (perf snapshots, KPI deltas).
